notes.conversion: Shrink each field-position bucket toward the yards-to-go prior.
notes.short_go: For 4th-and-1/2, smooth conversion, touchdown, and post-play field-position outcomes toward the yards-to-go prior.
notes.field_goal: Use a short moving window by kick distance, then shrink toward the global make rate.
notes.punt: Shrink sparse field-position bins toward the overall punt average.
notes.win_probability: Shrink each field-position bin toward its score/time prior.
